semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow, context-complete phrases in the visual-obligation registry create hard duties. Harem, reverse harem, zenana, odalisque, seraglio, haremlik, andarun, inner court, naemyeongbu, otome, polyamory, animal harem, and harem pants remain candidate-only when the requested visible relation is unspecified.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: Selected candidates must form one coherent six-part scene bundle: identifiable adult actors, a concrete action, a bounded location, task- or relation-bearing props, legible same-frame geometry, and an immediate result. Headcount, costume, luxury decor, gaze, labels, or mood alone never proves the concept.
semantic_policy.claim_boundary: Pixels may support only visible spatial access, household work, staged-art construction, concurrent bids, rivalry geometry, or route-key-art structure. They do not establish identity, ethnicity, nationality, religion, slavery, legal status, historical rank, sexual access, consent, relationship status, orientation, marriage, narrative ending, or zoological mating system.
semantic_policy.reference_boundary: A supplied portrait may guide only observable adult appearance, hair, face proportions, wardrobe, and framing. It never supplies identity, protected traits, historical status, household role, romantic role, consent, or cultural membership.
semantic_policy.judgment_boundary: Registry and prompt checks prove only data binding. A hard profile passes pixels only when every required component is simultaneously visible; partial visibility is failure, and requesting-user judgment remains separate.
